items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Joe Glavie is made solely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: Joe Glavie. Sunset. Sunset. And then Ness was across the street, yeah. So they wanted me to get a band, a recording band together. But I had to sign a contract. I was freelancing. I recorded with all the bands. You see? When you first recorded in Los Angeles?
